verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a library of markdown agent skill files, installed via npx or plugin marketplaces and invoked as slash commands. It has no programmatic API surface, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any API or API reference that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
